title: Netflix reveals the Grifters cast and drops a teaser
summary: GRIFTERS, Netflix’s new original Brazilian fiction series, has just revealed its cast in a brand-new teaser and behind-the-scenes photos from the video shoot.
body_markdown:
São Paulo, September 22, 2026


- “Hello! We've got an incredible deal for you. Can you just confirm your information?" What starts like just another everyday call reveals a world of easy money, flashy spending and online scams. This is the world of


GRIFTERS


, Netflix's original new Brazilian show, for which the cast and a brand new teaser have been revealed. Starring Samuel Naor (Biel) in his acting debut, the show also features Giovanna Cremonezi (Patrícia), Traplaudo (Richard), MC Chaverin (Lukinhas), MC Dricka (Thamyris), MC GP (TH) and Nath Fischer (Lara), who make up the show's Scam Gang, along with MC Nilo (Chacota). Charismatic, debauched, and hyper-connected, the kids discover that online scams could change their lives. But they quickly find themselves facing the consequences of their own decisions. Known as grifters, a common term for digital swindlers, they oscillate between a desire to improve their lives, the challenges of life on the outskirts of the city and the dilemmas that arise along the way. “


Grifters


uses online scams as a starting point to address relevant issues in Brazil, through the lens of society on the outskirts of São Paulo. We follow young people who find a shortcut to transform their lives but, over the course of that journey, they need to learn to live with the choices they've made, and their consequences. We wanted to create complex characters, driven by their ambitions and desires, with the contradictions that make us human. Casting was key to the process, combining new talents and artists who brought their own repertoire and insights to the characters and gave the show the energy and identity we were aiming for," says Kaique Alves, showrunner and one of the show's creators, alongside Konrad Dantas (KondZilla) and Felipe Braga. Chronically online, with fresh language,


Grifters


combines thriller and comedy elements as well as the unique culture of São Paulo's suburbs in a story about ambition, survival and how far people are willing to go in their search for more. Directed by Kaique Alves,


Grifters


was developed by KondZilla and LB Entertainment, and produced by Manas Filmes. The screenplay is by Thiago Dottori, Raul Perez, Donna Oliveira and Teodoro Poppovic. Episodes were directed by Daniel Lieff, Fred Ouro Preto, Gabriel Zerra, and Thatiane Almeida. The executive producers are Konrad Dantas, Rita Moraes, Felipe Braga, Kaique Alves, Bel Berlinck and Joana Cooper.


About Netflix


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About KondZilla


KondZilla is a production company and music label founded by Konrad Dantas, who has spent the past 14 years turning Brazilian funk into a global phenomenon. Nominated for an International Emmy (


Escola de Quebrada


, Paramount+) and nominated three times for a Latin Grammy, KondZilla is also the creator of


Sintonia


, Netflix’s most successful Brazilian franchise. The company is committed to developing both artistic and executive talent. Boasting over 68 million subscribers and 40 billion views, Canal KondZilla is Latin America's leading YouTube channel. Honored with prizes such as Cannes Lions, Clio Awards, The Caboré Award, and the Cinema Brazil Grand Prize, the company also founded the KondZilla Institute, which trains young people from underserved communities for careers in the creative sector.


About LB Entertainment


LB Entertainment is a production company and intellectual property developer that highlights new stories and emerging voices. Founded by Rita Moraes and Felipe Braga, the company is behind major hits such as


Lov3


(Amazon Prime Video, 2022),


Sintonia


(Netflix’s best-performing Brazilian series) and


Samantha!


(Netflix, 2018–2019).


Rauls


is its third project for the platform. The company is currently completing the post-production of the comedy


Nico


, starring Murilo Benício, and developing the series


Disciplina


for Globoplay. A two-time International Emmy nominee, for


Latitudes


and


A Vida Fora dos Campos


, and a four-time SXSW panelist, LB Entertainment has produced content for Netflix, HBO, Amazon, Warner Channel, YouTube Originals, Endemol and The Intercept.


About Manas Filmes


Manas Filmes is an independent production company committed to developing projects that tell original, impactful stories. Led by experienced producers Bel Berlinck and Joana Cooper, the company is producing its debut project with Netflix, the original series Rauls. Manas is also currently developing original projects and IP adaptations for various platforms.
